name: shiori-infrastructure-spike
description: The initial public web and API infrastructure slice for Shiori.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @shiori/web && npm run build --workspace @shiori/server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @shiori/server" "npm run dev --workspace @shiori/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:isolated
scripts.test:api: npm run test --workspace @shiori/server && npm run test:release-verifier
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @shiori/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @shiori/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run tests
